rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something very large in size or extent.

example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 uk1 hou2 daai6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when “massive” means severe or seriously affecting the body, rather than physically large.

example.english: The injury to their leg is massive.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zek3 goek3 soeng1 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when the object is bulky, heavy-looking, and solid, not merely extensive.

example.jyutping: ni1 gau6 sek6 zan1 hai6 daai6 gau6

rows.note: Use this attributive adjective for an extreme or utter degree, especially in emphatic modern speech.

example.english: This massive offer is a real bargain.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ciu1 kap1 jau1 wai6 zan1 hai6 dai2
